style: Grounded space-agency engineering realism with the restrained production design of a prestige science-fiction film. Photorealistic cinematic film still, anamorphic lens, natural film colour grade, deep blacks, ultra detailed. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no user interface, no logos, no flags, no insignia, no watermark.
videoStyle: Physically believable motion, steady cinematic camera, no cuts, no text, no logos. Keep the spacecraft's shape and markings exactly as in the first frame.

jobs.still: A long-range crew spacecraft floating in deep space, seen in three-quarter view from the front left, filling most of the frame. White and light-grey hull with visible panel seams and a few rust-orange accent stripes; a rounded cockpit with a dark wraparound glass canopy at the nose; a cylindrical mid body; two long dark-blue rectangular solar wings, one on each side; two smaller white radiator fins; a cluster of four engine bells at the rear glowing soft blue. Hard sunlight from the upper left, deep black sky with small sharp stars.
jobs.video: The camera slowly orbits a quarter turn around the spacecraft, from the front left toward its side, while the four rear engines brighten from a dim glow to a steady soft blue.

jobs.still: The same spacecraft as in the reference image, now small and distant in the middle of the frame, seen from the front, in an almost completely black field of deep space with only a few faint stars. Its four rear engines give a faint soft blue glow that rims its hull. Very dark, quiet, mysterious.
jobs.video: The camera drifts slowly and steadily toward the distant spacecraft, which grows larger in the middle of the frame as more stars fade in and its blue engine glow brightens.

jobs.still: The same spacecraft as in the reference image seen from directly behind and slightly above, its four engine bells burning bright blue-white, flying away from the camera into deep space toward a small distant blue Earth with a tiny grey Moon beside it. Stars sharp against black.
jobs.video: The spacecraft accelerates away from the camera; its engines flare brighter, and the stars begin to stretch into short streaks past the camera as the camera follows behind it.

jobs.still: The same spacecraft as in the reference image in low orbit above the Earth, small in the upper third of the frame, with the curved blue horizon of the Earth filling the lower half: white cloud bands over deep blue ocean and a thin glowing line of atmosphere against black space. Sunlight glints on its solar wings.
jobs.video: The spacecraft glides slowly forward along its orbit while the clouds and ocean of the Earth turn gently underneath and the thin blue line of the atmosphere glows on the horizon.

jobs.still: The same spacecraft as in the reference image flying low over the grey surface of the Moon toward the horizon, seen from behind and above. Large craters, scattered boulders and long black shadows from a low Sun; in the distance a wide dark pit in a flat lava plain with a small white station and a field of solar panels at its rim, tiny warm lights glowing. Pure black sky with no stars near the bright ground, a small blue Earth low over the horizon.
jobs.video: A low forward flight over the cratered lunar surface: the ground and its long shadows slide toward the camera as the spacecraft heads for the distant station at the rim of the pit.

A meteoroid strikes the lunar surface near the station: a silent bright flash, a spray of grey dust and rocks thrown outward in straight lines with no air to slow them, and amber emergency lights begin to pulse on the station. No sound, no fire, no smoke: there is no air on the Moon.

jobs.still: The same spacecraft as in the reference image seen from behind on the left side of the frame, coasting through deep space toward Mars, which is a small rust-red disc with faint darker markings and a white polar cap far ahead on the right. Engines dim. Deep black sky with sharp stars.
jobs.video: The spacecraft coasts silently toward Mars; the red planet slowly grows larger ahead while the stars stay still.

jobs.still: A squat white landing craft with four legs descending on bright engine flames toward a rust-brown rocky Martian plain, kicking up a ring of tan dust beneath it. In the middle distance a small outpost of white habitat modules with a low dome, a pink-glowing greenhouse tunnel and a field of solar panels, as in the second reference image. A butterscotch-tan hazy sky with a small pale Sun; a tall wall of dust from an approaching storm on the horizon.
jobs.video: The landing craft descends slowly on its engines and touches down; a ring of tan dust billows outward along the ground and drifts away, while the dust storm on the horizon creeps closer.

jobs.still: The same spacecraft as in the reference image, small in the lower left, flying away from the camera into deep space. Ahead of it, in one wide view: the large blue Earth on the right partly in shadow, the small grey Moon near it, and far away to the left a tiny rust-red point that is Mars. A soft glow from the Sun just out of frame. Quiet, vast, hopeful.
jobs.video: The camera pulls slowly backward as the spacecraft flies on toward the worlds ahead, its engines a steady soft blue; the Earth and the Moon drift very slightly.
